test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sentences uses the word "wave" with the same meaning as in the "She gave a friendly wave to her neighbor"

options.text: The dog loved to chase the waves on the beach.
The crowd gave a slow wave as the parade passed by.
The ocean waves crashed against the shore.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. The crowd gave a slow wave as the parade passed by.
